name: Conformance level
description: The gov-schema conformance level a publisher claims, per SPEC section 4. The ladder exists so a small authority can publish something genuinely useful on day one instead of bouncing off a forty-field requirement. Claims are verified, not taken on trust.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Core
hasDefinedTerm.description: Jurisdiction and Organization present and correctly separated, each with an @id and at least one identifier.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Standard
hasDefinedTerm.description: Core, plus every required field of each profile in use, all references resolving, and every organization placed in the territorial hierarchy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Extended
hasDefinedTerm.description: Standard, plus recommended optional fields and a machine-readable link to the source standard the data is derived from.
